title: feat: Add RFC 8707 resource parameter support for JWT access tokens

# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue
Closes #2149

---

## 🚀 Summary
Adds RFC 8707 resource parameter support to OAuth flows, enabling OAuth providers (e.g., BetterAuth) to return JWT access tokens instead of opaque tokens. Fixes "Invalid Compact JWS" errors when using JWT-capable OAuth providers.

---

## 🧪 Checks
- [x] `make lint` passes
- [x] `make test` passes  
- [x] CHANGELOG updated

---

## 📓 Notes

**Changes:**
- Modified `oauth_router.py` to add `resource` parameter in both `/authorize` and `/callback` endpoints
- Updated `oauth_manager.py` to pass through resource parameter in authorization URL and token exchange
- Added CHANGELOG entry documenting the feature

**RFC 8707 Resource Indicators:**
The resource parameter tells the OAuth server which resource (MCP server URL) the access token is for. JWT-capable OAuth providers use this to mint audience-specific JWT tokens. Without it, providers default to opaque tokens.
